description: This Java source file contains the EnumToString class, which reads C header files defining enums, extracts enum definitions, and generates corresponding C++ code and header files that provide string representations for enum values. The program automates the conversion of enum definitions into switch-case functions returning enum names as strings.

classes.name: EnumToString
classes.description: A utility class for generating C++ functions and headers that map enum values to their string names based on input C header files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that validates arguments, initializes string builders, and calls processing methods to generate C++ and header files from input header files.

methods.name: writeCppAndHeaderFiles
methods.description: Writes the accumulated C++ code and header content into corresponding files.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads, parses, and processes the input enum header file to extract enum definitions and generate corresponding switch-case code and header declarations.

methods.name: removeSpaces
methods.description: Removes all whitespace characters from a string to standardize line parsing.

methods.name: isKeyValueLine
methods.description: Checks if a line within enum definitions matches the pattern of a key or key-value line, indicating an enum entry.

methods.name: makeCode
methods.description: Generates the C++ switch-case function for a given enum, returning the string representation of enum values.

methods.name: getMethodSignature
methods.description: Creates the function signature string for the string conversion function of a specific enum.

methods.name: capitalize
methods.description: Capitalizes the first letter of a given string, used to generate method names.
